scientific_matrix: Strict schema and independent evaluator controls; I3 repairs nested-input crashes, endpoint-cancellation false acceptance and inadmissible impulses. Prefix checks use unchanged record-scale tolerance and cannot disambiguate co-timed intermediate event states.
Own inventory/coverage contract and factual identifiers retained. Completeness against every future external registry is not certified; external source implementation is excluded.

Analytical support couples, sliding/capture, restitution, transported gaps, wrench reporting, constraints and first-order free fall challenged. Arbitrary coupled impacts/rotated devices and all parameter regimes are not exhaustively qualified.

CMJ/SJ/vest-loaded CMJ and separable shoulder-shelf jump squat are numerical fixtures. Ordinary hand-stabilized jump squat and physiological landing peaks/RFD are NOT_EVALUABLE; drop/rebound models are NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

Modeled back-squat repetitions and support closure verified. Controller ringing retained; COM pseudo-work and vertical bar-contact work estimate named explicitly. Human technique/metabolic work unsupported.
Modeled deadlift pre-tension, bar-floor support transfer and return verified. Settling retained; stationary support/contact work differs from COM pseudo-work.

Rep mechanics remain numerical fixtures; whole-support helper requires rack reaction/established absence. Whole-record stable supine support is NOT_EVALUABLE: actual unrack/rerack/release openings and gaps retained.

Default floor clean/snatch pulls close declared equations. Robust general Olympic technique is SCIENTIFICALLY_UNSUPPORTED by retained 8/10 adversarial failures; rigid-impact physical peaks/RFD NOT_EVALUABLE; hang/block starts NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Pull-only subset and reach-domain refusal verified; full power-clean turnover/catch/front rack NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Planar surrogate infeasibility is not evidence that humans cannot catch.

10/10 curated numerical positives and 76/76 authored fault detections reproduced in separate processes; real hosted Windows/Linux qualification added in I3. Empirical bilateral attribution, anatomical sensor-phase inference and paired human/device validity NOT_EVALUABLE.
